description.zh: 两条独立的图片通道：read 把图直接送进模型上下文，让 AI 真正看见画面而不是 OCR 文字；send 把图发到对话里给用户看。另有 read_screen 一步截屏并看图。支持设备路径、VFS 路径与工作区相对路径。
description.en: Two separate image channels: read feeds images straight into the model context so the AI actually sees the picture instead of OCR text; send posts images into the conversation for the user. Also includes read_screen for one-step capture-and-view. Accepts device paths, VFS paths and workspace-relative paths.

description.zh: read_image / send_image / read_screen 三个工具
